name: § 49, point b – 123
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (b) reject any restoration above the draft budget for the European Economic and Social Committee and call for a reduction of its administrative, translation, communication, meeting and building expenditure; insist that any demonstrably necessary security or cyber-security reinforcement in the other institutions be financed first through redeployment, shared services and reductions in non-essential expenditure;
